text:
Alex M.: PR #4823 up — canary reversion for conn-pool tweaks that caused the 03:22 latency spike. Need 2 approvals + someone to trigger canary deploy when ready. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-inference/pull/4823

Oncall Bot: [ALERT] 2026-02-25 03:22 UTC - high p95 latency on router (svc=router-frontend). Alert fired, auto-rollbacks attempted but failed due to config drift. See incident: https://intranet.redwood/incident/INC-2026-021

Priya R.: dropping in — can you paste the rollback diff and quick repro steps?

Alex M.: sure. main change is revert of connpool backoff logic. Diff in PR. Repro is easy locally with load test (k6). Quick commands:
```
kubectl -n prod set image deploy/router router=router:v1.12.3-canary-revert
kubectl -n prod rollout status deploy/router
# to run smoke load
k6 run --vus 50 --duration 60s smoke.js
```

Samir K.: can we add a short smoke check in the PR? last time a patch changed headers and broke routing.

Alex M.: yeah adding a smoke test now, will push in a minute.

Taylor S.: pinging @Samir K. and @Maria G. for reviews — if we can get approvals in next 30m we can canary during the low-traffic window.

Maria G.: taking a look now. quick note: please include changelog line and a rollback note in the release.

Priya R.: LGTM once smoke test is green.

Maria G.: Approved.

Samir K.: Approved after small nits fixed (commented inline). @Alex M. once you push fixes I can merge and kick the canary.

Alex M.: pushed fixes. merging once Samir hits merge button.

Samir K.: merged and started canary deploy at 1771203600

Oncall Bot: [DEPLOY] canary rollout started at 2026-02-25 03:40 UTC. Track: https://deploys.redwood/rollouts/555

Alex M.: monitoring — p95 dropping back to baseline. keeping an eye for 15m.

Taylor S.: thanks all. if it stays healthy, we'll promote to full within the hour. :thumbsup:

Alex M.: update: 30m in - all good, promoting to stable now.

Oncall Bot: [SUCCESS] full rollout completed at 2026-02-25 04:12 UTC. No errors.

Maria G.: nice work.

Priya R.: great, thanks for the quick turnaround everyone.
